hotpaths.meaning: Repeated execution paths for solving tasks, not filesystem path popularity alone
hotpaths.ranking: Rank by estimated avoidable total cost (traversals * measured avoidable cost per traversal), constrained by memory and artifact size budgets; frequency alone is not sufficient.
stages: Measure representative cold/warm workloads with identical mandatory gates
Deduplicate immutable content by cryptographic content identity and preserve references/provenance
Reuse exact-key build and runtime cache entries
Review native lowering or AOT only for measured hot paths with established semantics
Use PGO for matching workloads; consider link-time optimization and hot/cold layout with compatible declared tools
Validate correctness and benchmark unseen workloads against baseline; retain successor only within explicit regression budgets
hotpaths.tool_admission: LLVM/Clang/llvm-profdata/BOLT/LTO are candidates, not admitted tools. Extend toolchain locks, registry, cache, license and self-test contracts before use.
hotpaths.space_rule: Native code, inlining and profiles can increase size. Accept only measured size/resource tradeoffs; no blanket claim that compilation saves space.

reactivation.discovery: Reuse repository-native backlog and continuation mechanisms; open issue-agent branches alone are not a complete inventory of work/* and staging/* tasks.
eligibility: task is still authorized and relevant
current sources policies and gates freshly observed
no competing writer and expected-head lease acquired
trigger is a recovered dependency, changed relevant policy/source, due retry condition or explicit owner action
decision_order: HOLD if mandatory observation, authorization or dependency is unavailable
REBASE_AND_REVALIDATE if source binding changed without proven semantic invalidation
REVALIDATE if current criteria differ or old evidence is stale/incomplete
RESTART_FROM_LAST_VALID_BOUNDARY if artifacts or procedure cannot satisfy current rules
RESTART_FROM_ZERO if no checkpoint can be validated under current rules
RESUME only from an exact checkpoint valid under all current mandatory criteria
NOOP for unchanged blocker and unchanged evidence
restart_semantics: Archive old attempt and its status; do not erase or relabel historical results
Create successor attempt linked to predecessor
Recreate current acceptance conditions before executing
Recompute affected derivatives; preserve still-valid immutable sources only
Run all currently applicable gates and fresh effect readback
reactivation.retry_policy: Bounded backoff; permanent blockers retried only after a relevant change; a missing timestamp is HOLD, never an epoch-zero retry.
reactivation.exactly_once: Claim compare-and-swap lease; persist request hash and execution id; reobserve after ambiguous dispatch before retry.

feedback.suppress: Unchanged blocked state and repeated identical fingerprints
content: next safe step and retry condition
feedback.delivery_requirement: An Action artifact or queue entry is not observed delivery to Ingolf. Bind configured QIK-VRT channel and delivery receipt; mark delivery pending until readback.

acceptance: warm and cold paths preserve mandatory checks
policy change invalidates previous procedural acceptance
incompatible checkpoint produces restart plan, not RESUME
completed historical attempt is preserved and separate from current acceptance
unchanged blocker produces NOOP and no repeated notification
no duplicate dispatch on ambiguous transport
lost capability or unreadable authority produces HOLD
benchmarks bind inputs and code; no speed/size superiority inferred
notification is complete only with configured QIK-VRT delivery readback

human_activity_minimization.scope: Every admitted task, requirements workflow, repository work unit and role-bound personal-assistant flow; prioritize reducing Ingolf's necessary activity.
human_activity_minimization.objective: Minimize necessary human interventions and human handling time for comparable verified useful task outcomes. Routine reversible and already-authorized work proceeds autonomously.
rules: Reuse existing explicit authorizations and stable corrections; do not ask for the same authorization again.
Resolve routine deterministic implementation choices from current evidence and scope.
Continue safe independent authorized work while one dependent route is blocked.
Ask only for a genuinely missing non-deterministic decision, authentication/admission or mandatory authority predicate that has no admitted autonomous route.
Prepare and verify the concrete reviewable result before any necessary final human approval.
Group related decisions when doing so preserves clear effect scope and minimizes human effort.
Notify for material changed evidence, an actionable required human step or verified completion; unchanged blocker is NOOP.
Every necessary human intervention names the precise missing predicate, its evidence, why the available execution route cannot satisfy it and the smallest concrete action.
Retain owner's ability to correct, reprioritize or stop; never fabricate consent, independent review or effect acceptance.

metrics.human_handling_time: observed duration when supplied by actual telemetry; unknown is unknown
metrics.primary_comparison: necessary human interventions per comparable accepted useful outcome; zero-outcome denominator remains undefined/HOLD
metrics.secondary_comparison: accepted useful outcomes per human handling time; report uncertainty and matched conditions

main_development_thread.purpose: Complete and implement the defined QIK-VRT Authority and Mirror capabilities; refine undefined requirements until current unambiguous observable acceptance can be established.
main_development_thread.finite_acceptance_unit: A versioned task or release has a bounded explicitly inventoried requirement scope. The continuing development goal is not globally DONE because one task, PR, test suite or release is accepted.
main_development_thread.source_admission: Normative specification, implementation, PR/branch/issue and Owner correction are typed sources. A proposal is not automatically an accepted requirement, execution authority or functioning implementation.

related_work_strands.identity_and_content: Keep existing personal strand identities, payloads, correspondence and delivery records in the admitted private principal/profile store.
related_work_strands.prioritization: Main is the durable project goal; declared imminent deadlines or higher-impact admissible work in another strand may take precedence. Preserve every authorized strand unless explicitly cancelled or superseded.

requirement_engineering.ready_for_implementation: Every mandatory field is explicit or has a justified NOT_APPLICABLE disposition, source/procedure are current, and no unresolved decision prevents the scoped implementation. READINESS is neither authorization nor execution/effect acceptance.
requirement_engineering.autonomous_clarification: Resolve deterministic routine choices through current contracts and prior authorizations. A missing routine detail alone does not trigger a question.
necessary_owner_question: Identify exact unresolved requirement and missing decision
State evidence, why existing contracts cannot resolve it and which predicate it blocks
Prepare concrete feasible alternatives and consequences
Request smallest decision; preserve unrelated autonomous progress
requirement_engineering.correction: Latest explicit Owner correction creates a successor revision. Historical source, decisions and receipts remain immutable; affected acceptance/tests are invalidated and revalidated or restarted.
requirement_engineering.requirement_contradiction: Preserve disagreement and concrete scope; do not silently rewrite a requirement or infer consensus.

effect_ack_including_human_feedback.identity: Use the actually authenticated principal and admitted private profile through existing REST transport. A declared name, public terminal event or repository write does not authenticate the personal Twin.
effect_ack_including_human_feedback.distinction: RECEIVED != WELL_DEFINED != IMPLEMENTED != VERIFIED_EFFECT != ACCEPTED; authorization != observed human usefulness or decision.
effect_ack_including_human_feedback.persistence: Reuse existing private CAS store and append-only ledger; stable input/task/decision identities and expected versions bind replay/recovery. No new storage or scheduler.
owner_feedback_required_when: Genuine unresolved Owner decision blocks current requirement
Material conflict with an explicitly declared goal/principle
Current criteria invalidate attempt and require restart
New blocker or materially changed retry condition
Verified task-specific useful result needs human acceptance for declared scope
effect_ack_including_human_feedback.recurrence: Existing QIK-VRT continuation/scheduling mechanisms retain open requirements and material retry conditions. Suppress unchanged fingerprints; missing decisions remain open across restart.
effect_ack_including_human_feedback.delivery: Bind configured authorized QIK-VRT human channel, delivery attempt and independent channel-specific readback. Keep RECEIPT_PENDING until observed delivery; a queued artifact, prepared prompt or accepted HTTP response is not proof that Ingolf received or understood it.
effect_ack_including_human_feedback.understanding_or_acceptance: Do not infer consent, understanding or benefit from delivery. Preserve actual human feedback when needed for scope; do not demand acknowledgement of every routine notification.
effect_ack_including_human_feedback.stopped_or_corrected_by_owner: Honor explicit stop/correction, retain supersession/history and invalidate affected queued actions before execution.

human_context_coverage.owner_goal: Function in every humanly compatible situation.
human_context_coverage.acceptance_interpretation: Continuing coverage requirement: every declared supported context has an end-to-end acceptance case; newly encountered compatible situations enter requirement engineering and remain OPEN until verified. A finite suite does not prove unlimited universal functionality.
human_context_coverage.out_of_verified_coverage: Retain the requirement and unsupported edge; use an already authorized compatible channel if actually available; seek only a genuinely necessary smallest Owner decision. No silent success or fabricated delivery.
